name: delegate-skills
tagline_zh: 把编码任务丢给独立代理跑，你只审 diff 再提交。一个代理干一件事，别让 AI 抢你键盘。
tagline_en: Hand off coding to a separate agent CLI, review the diff, commit yourself. One task per agent, no more AI.
desc_en: Delegate a coding task to a separate coding agent CLI, review the diff, land the commit yourself — one per implementer.
why_zh: 同类工具多让 AI 直接改代码，这个强制你保留最终提交权，且每个代理只干一件活，避免上下文污染。
why_en: Unlike tools that let AI edit directly, this keeps you as the committer and isolates each agent to one task, preventing context.
